whenToUse: Consent must legally be obtained at sign-up.
Required and optional terms are mixed.
The full terms can be opened right away.
whenNotToUse: There's only one set of terms (a one-line consent sentence).
You'd mix required and optional terms in the same style.

alternatives.name: Social Sign-in
alternatives.reason: Choosing how to sign up before consenting.

accessibility: When only some are checked, Agree to all shows the mixed state as indeterminate.
Required and optional are labeled in words, not left to color.
View buttons include the name of the terms.
The next button stays disabled until all required terms are chosen.
